issues.detail: The Hebrew name מַחֲזִיאוֹת (Machzi'ot) is rendered as 'Mát-xi-ốt', which is a different name; the correct transliteration should be 'Mát-xi-ốt'? Actually the Hebrew is מַחֲזִיאוֹת (Machzi'ot), and the Vietnamese 'Mát-xi-ốt' is a reasonable transliteration, but the issue is the ordinal: Hebrew says 'to the twenty-third for Machzi'ot' (לִשְׁלֹשָׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים לְמַחֲזִיאוֹת), meaning the 23rd division belongs to Machzi'ot. The Vietnamese says 'Đời thứ hai mươi ba thuộc về Mát-xi-ốt' which is correct. However, the Hebrew has 'bānav we'eḥāw' (his sons and his brothers) — the Vietnamese says 'các con trai, anh em ông ấy' which is correct. The number 'twelve' is correct. The issue is that the Hebrew phrase 'לִשְׁלֹשָׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים לְמַחֲזִיאוֹת' is a construct: 'for the twenty-third, for Machzi'ot' — the Vietnamese 'Đời thứ hai mươi ba thuộc về Mát-xi-ốt' is fine. Actually the name is correct. The real issue: the Hebrew says 'bānav we'eḥāw' (his sons and his brothers) — the Vietnamese says 'các con trai, anh em ông ấy' which is correct. The number is correct. So why flag? The name 'Mát-xi-ốt' is a transliteration of מַחֲזִיאוֹת (Machzi'ot) — that is acceptable. But the Hebrew has 'לִשְׁלֹשָׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים' = 'to the twenty-third' — the Vietnamese 'Đời thứ hai mươi ba' is correct. So actually the translation is faithful. However, the Hebrew has 'בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו' (his sons and his brothers) — the Vietnamese 'các con trai, anh em ông ấy' is correct. So why did I flag? I need to re-examine: the Hebrew text is 'לִשְׁלֹשָׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים לְמַחֲזִיאוֹת בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר' — this is from 1 Chronicles 24:16? Actually it's the 23rd lot for Machzi'ot, his sons and brothers, twelve. The Vietnamese is accurate. So the verdict should be OK. But I flagged because I thought the name was wrong — it's not. Let me correct: the name is fine. The translation is faithful. So verdict OK. But the instruction says only flag if a Vietnamese reader would come away believing something factually different. Here nothing is different. So OK. I will change to OK.
